page.notes: Long s rendered as s throughout. The printed marks a, b, c, d and e are in the text as superscript letters; the Greek is absent on this page. The asterisk after "summum" is read as mark a. The notes "Onia sa- cerdos." and "Sacerdo- tium ve- nale." are partly worn and doubtful. "Iosephus lib. 12. c. 6." is read from a worn margin. The final line "rat," is the continuation of "intule-rat," and not a catchword. The running head is in capitals as printed.
